description: Quote a Kinetiq Elysium testnet bridge transfer between HyperEVM testnet (998) and Kinetiq Elysium Testnet (99801). Quote-only and non-executable: never signs, broadcasts or returns a transaction; testnet values are unpriced. Mainnet unsupported until published.

amount.description: Amount in base units (wei), decimal string.

direction.description: deposit = 998 to 99801; withdrawal = 99801 to 998. Or give fromChainId/toChainId.

from.description: Optional sender; enables the live retryable submission-fee read on deposits.

maxGas.description: Optional deposit L2 gas limit; default is the documented example, labelled estimated.

network.description: mainnet is refused: no Kinetiq Elysium mainnet is published.

path.description: Withdrawal path; mirror is refused until verified.

to.description: Recipient address on the destination chain.

token.description: HyperEVM testnet (998) ERC-20 address, both directions.

name: kinetiq_elysium_bridge_quote
